## Description

Proposed distributionally robust approach to robust portfolio optimization: Choose portfolio weights while allowing for uncertainty in estimated return distributions or tail losses; the uncertainty set, risk measure, and constraints require explicit definitions. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
